12967.d: The Guthixian temple is an ancient temple devoted to Guthix found in the While Guthix Sleeps quest.

gt.heading: Entrance
gt.text:
The entrance is first accessed during While Guthix Sleeps. Like the magic stone mine, the entrance is accessed by using a sapphire lantern on a light creature.

While Guthix Sleeps quest locations:
• Three skeletons (not monsters) that the player can search to find items needed for the quest
• Brazier with a fire orb (needs to be dug out and chiselled)
• Brazier with a earth orb (needs to be dug out and chiselled)
• Brazier with a air orb (needs to be chiselled out)
• Brazier with a water orb (needs to be chiselled out)
• Three lower stone skulls and tunnels. The player uses elemental orbs on the skulls to obtain elemental keys. The player later climbs through the skulls' nose cavities to use three of the keys.
• The upper stone skull, used to access the temple
